$comment: Shared project permissions. This file is TRACKED on purpose: the bug-hunt
loop runs in a git worktree (../STR-loop), and an untracked
settings.local.json does not travel there -- the loop then has no allowlist
at all and is denied on its first Bash call.
Headless `claude -p` cannot answer a prompt, so anything on 'ask' is
effectively denied. The loop needs to commit, so commit is allowed here.
That is safe because commits are local and reversible, and because the real
gate is .git/hooks/pre-commit, which runs the full suite and refuses to let
a loop branch weaken a test, touch a Windows-only file, or stage bank data.
push stays OUT of allow: the pre-push hook refuses loop/* branches, and a
human decides what reaches a remote.
